newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down on position-squaring.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down on position-squaring.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended sharply down on Monday on heavy position-sqauring by small investors and dealers said they expected sentiment to remain depressed in the near term.

"The index's sharp slide shows that most holdings were made by small players, who are unable to hold their positions," dealer Sajjad Mankani said. "There is some positive news, but genuine investors are on the sidelines."
The Karachi 100-share index fell 21.83 points, or 1.47 percent, to end at 1,464.50. Losers led gainers 169 to 73. Dewan Salman Fibre fell 0.30 rupees to 34.50. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
